newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech govt to sell petrol firm Benzina in tender.
newsitem.headline: Czech govt to sell petrol firm Benzina in tender.

text.p: The Czech cabinet agreed to privatise petrol retailer Benzina s.p. through a public tender, Deputy Prime Minister Jiri Skalicky said on Wednesday.
The minister, speaking at a news conference following a cabinet session, said that the company was formed in the division of the former monopoly petroleum retailer into Benzina a.s. and Benzina s.p.

Benzina s.p. has been selling off petrol stations and currently holds less than 200 stations, compared with the about 300 belonging to Benzina a.s., which is now owned by the petrochemical holding Unipetrol a.s..
